questions.q:
Choose the option that provides the correct/improved form of the sentence.
The newly appointed chief executive officer has been working under the assumption that the quarterly revenue targets could be achieved without downsizing the operations department.
o: had been worked under the assumption
questions.e:
The Present Perfect Continuous tense (“has been working”) correctly describes an action that started in the past and is still continuing. “Under the assumption” is the standard expression, so no improvement is required. 

Hindi Explanation: “Has been working” का प्रयोग ऐसे कार्य के लिए सही है जो अतीत में शुरू हुआ और अभी भी जारी है। “Under the assumption” मानक और सही expression है, इसलिए कोई सुधार आवश्यक नहीं है।
questions.eh: “Has been working” का प्रयोग ऐसे कार्य के लिए सही है जो अतीत में शुरू हुआ और अभी भी जारी है। “Under the assumption” मानक और सही expression है, इसलिए कोई सुधार आवश्यक नहीं है।

questions.q:
Identify the option that contains an incorrectly spelt word.
A. The corporate restructuring caused significant administrative inconvenience.
B. Superstitious beliefs often hinder the development of a scientific temperament.
C. The chef prepared an exquisite dessert featuring an assortment of exotic fruits.
D. The hypercritical analysis of the movie received widespread public critisism.
o: The corporate restructuring caused significant administrative inconvenience.
Superstitious beliefs often hinder the development of a scientific temperament.
The chef prepared an exquisite dessert featuring an assortment of exotic fruits.
The hypercritical analysis of the movie received widespread public critisism.
questions.e:
D is incorrect because “critisism” is misspelt; the correct spelling is “criticism.”

Vocabulary: A. Inconvenience = trouble or difficulty; synonyms: trouble, difficulty, nuisance; antonyms: convenience, ease, advantage. B. Superstitious = based on irrational beliefs; synonyms: credulous, irrational, unscientific; antonyms: rational, scientific, skeptical. C. Exquisite = extremely beautiful or delicate; synonyms: elegant, refined, superb; antonyms: crude, ordinary, coarse. D. Criticism = disapproval or evaluation; synonyms: censure, disapproval, reproach; antonyms: praise, approval, commendation.

Hindi Explanation: D में “critisism” की spelling गलत है; सही spelling “criticism” है।
A. Inconvenience = असुविधा/परेशानी। B. Superstitious = अंधविश्वासी। C. Exquisite = अत्यंत सुंदर/उत्कृष्ट। D. Criticism = आलोचना।
questions.eh:
D में “critisism” की spelling गलत है; सही spelling “criticism” है।

questions.q:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.
The committee members, having spent over three hours deliberating the intricate nuances of the corporate merger, was explicitly reluctant to ratify the proposed clause despite the chairperson’s persuasive remarks.
o: The committee members, having spent over three hours
deliberating the intricate nuances of the corporate merger,
was explicitly reluctant to ratify the proposed clause
questions.e:
The error is in C. The subject “committee members” is plural, so the verb must be “were,” not “was.” The participial phrase “having spent...” does not change the subject. 

Hindi Explanation: त्रुटि C में है। “Committee members” plural subject है, इसलिए verb “were” होना चाहिए, “was” नहीं। “Having spent...” वाला phrase subject को नहीं बदलता।
questions.eh: त्रुटि C में है। “Committee members” plural subject है, इसलिए verb “were” होना चाहिए, “was” नहीं। “Having spent...” वाला phrase subject को नहीं बदलता।

questions.q:
Choose the correct indirect-speech form of the given sentence.
The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness, "Can you state with absolute certainty that you observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight?"
o: The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he could state with absolute certainty that he observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he could state with absolute certainty that he had observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney inquired from the prime witness that whether he can state with absolute certainty that he had observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he can state with absolute certainty that he observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.
questions.e:
In indirect speech, “Can” changes to “could” after the past reporting verb “asked.” The earlier observation is appropriately represented by “had observed.” “Asked” takes “if/whether,” not “that whether.”

Hindi Explanation: Indirect speech में past reporting verb “asked” के बाद “can” सामान्यतः “could” हो जाता है। पहले हुई observation को “had observed” से दिखाया गया है। “Asked” के साथ “if/whether” आता है, “that whether” नहीं।
questions.eh: Indirect speech में past reporting verb “asked” के बाद “can” सामान्यतः “could” हो जाता है। पहले हुई observation को “had observed” से दिखाया गया है। “Asked” के साथ “if/whether” आता है, “that whether” नहीं।

questions.q:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.
In an era dominated by rapid globalization, maintaining an insular approach to foreign policy can severely alienate a developing country from its global allies. (Find Antonym)
questions.e:
The target word is “insular,” meaning narrow-minded or uninterested in cultures and ideas outside one’s own experience. B. Cosmopolitan is the antonym.

Option meanings: A. Parochial = narrow or limited in outlook (synonym of insular). B. Cosmopolitan = familiar with and open to many cultures (antonym). C. Detached = separate or emotionally uninvolved. D. Prejudiced = having preconceived and often unfair opinions.

Target vocabulary: Synonyms — Parochial, Provincial, Illiberal. Antonyms — Cosmopolitan, Broad-minded, Universal.

Hindi Explanation: “Insular” का अर्थ है संकीर्ण सोच वाला या बाहरी संस्कृतियों/विचारों में रुचि न रखने वाला। इसका antonym B. Cosmopolitan है।
A. Parochial = संकीर्ण/सीमित दृष्टिकोण वाला। B. Cosmopolitan = विभिन्न संस्कृतियों से परिचित और उदार। C. Detached = अलग या असंबद्ध। D. Prejudiced = पूर्वाग्रह से ग्रस्त।
Synonyms: Parochial, Provincial, Illiberal. Antonyms: Cosmopolitan, Broad-minded, Universal.

questions.q:
Arrange the sentences in the most logical sequence.
P: While green energy sources like solar and wind power offer a sustainable alternative, their intermittent nature presents a significant operational hurdle for heavy industries.
Q: To resolve this grid instability, engineering firms are investing heavily in advanced lithium-ion battery storage infrastructure.
R: The global transition toward a carbon-neutral economy requires an immediate and massive overhaul of existing power grids.
S: Without these robust storage systems, manufacturing plants risk frequent operational blackouts during seasonal weather changes.
questions.e:
R introduces the broad topic of the power-grid overhaul. P narrows the discussion to the intermittency problem. Q gives the storage solution, and S explains the consequence without that solution. Hence, RPQS (A).

Hindi Explanation: R मुख्य विषय यानी power-grid overhaul को प्रस्तुत करता है। P renewable energy की intermittency वाली समस्या बताता है। Q उसका storage solution देता है और S बताता है कि storage न होने पर क्या परिणाम होगा। इसलिए क्रम RPQS (A) है।
questions.eh: R मुख्य विषय यानी power-grid overhaul को प्रस्तुत करता है। P renewable energy की intermittency वाली समस्या बताता है। Q उसका storage solution देता है और S बताता है कि storage न होने पर क्या परिणाम होगा। इसलिए क्रम RPQS (A) है।

questions.q:
Choose the option that gives the correct meaning of the idiom.

To stay vigilant against internal corporate espionage

questions.q:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.
Despite of the unrelenting downpour and the subsequent waterlogging across the primary arterial roads, the dedicated medical staff managed to reach the emergency ward right on time.
o: and the subsequent waterlogging across the primary arterial roads,
the dedicated medical staff managed to reach
the emergency ward right on time.
questions.e:
The error is in A. “Despite” is not followed by “of.” Use “Despite the unrelenting downpour” or “In spite of the unrelenting downpour.”

Hindi Explanation: त्रुटि A में है। “Despite” के बाद “of” नहीं आता। सही रूप “Despite the unrelenting downpour” या “In spite of the unrelenting downpour” होगा।
questions.eh: त्रुटि A में है। “Despite” के बाद “of” नहीं आता। सही रूप “Despite the unrelenting downpour” या “In spite of the unrelenting downpour” होगा।

questions.q:
Choose the correct passive-voice form of the given sentence.
The architectural firm meticulously designed the futuristic blueprint of the smart city to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
o: The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was being meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
The futuristic blueprint of the smart city had been meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
To ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources, the futuristic blueprint of the smart city is meticulously designed by the architectural firm.
questions.e:
The active verb “designed” is in Simple Past. Its passive form is “was/were + V3.” The object “the futuristic blueprint” becomes the passive subject, so “was meticulously designed” is correct.

Hindi Explanation: “Designed” Simple Past में है। इसका passive form “was/were + V3” होगा। Object “the futuristic blueprint” passive sentence का subject बनता है, इसलिए “was meticulously designed” सही है।
questions.eh: “Designed” Simple Past में है। इसका passive form “was/were + V3” होगा। Object “the futuristic blueprint” passive sentence का subject बनता है, इसलिए “was meticulously designed” सही है।
questions.instruction: Choose the correct passive-voice form of the given sentence.

questions.q:
Choose the correct indirect-speech form of the given sentence.
The project coordinator said to the team members, "Do not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month."
o: The project coordinator warned the team members not to compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays the following month.
The project coordinator told the team members to not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator ordered the team members that they should not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator warned the team members against compromising on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays the following month.
questions.e:
A negative imperative can be reported as “warned/told + object + not to.” Because the reporting verb is in the past, “will” changes to “would,” and “next month” changes to “the following month.”

Hindi Explanation: Negative imperative को “warned/told + object + not to” से report किया जा सकता है। Past reporting verb के कारण “will” → “would” और “next month” → “the following month” होगा।
questions.eh: Negative imperative को “warned/told + object + not to” से report किया जा सकता है। Past reporting verb के कारण “will” → “would” और “next month” → “the following month” होगा।

questions.q:
Choose the word that best describes the person given in the statement.
A person who holds an unconventional, non-conformist, and independent view, especially in social, artistic, or political matters, refusing to follow the rules of a group.
questions.e:
A. Maverick is correct: an unconventional or independent-minded person.

A. Maverick — an unconventional person; synonyms: Nonconformist, Dissenter, Rebel; antonyms: Conformist, Traditionalist, Conventionalist.
B. Altruist — a person concerned with others’ welfare; synonyms: Philanthropist, Benefactor, Humanitarian; antonyms: Egoist, Selfish person, Misanthrope.
C. Sycophant — a person who flatters an influential person for personal advantage; synonyms: Toady, Flatterer, Bootlicker; antonyms: Critic, Detractor, Opponent.
D. Epicure — a person who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink; synonyms: Gourmet, Connoisseur, Epicurean; antonyms: Ascetic, Abstemious person, Teetotaller.

Hindi Explanation: A. Maverick = परंपरा से अलग स्वतंत्र सोच वाला व्यक्ति; synonyms: Nonconformist, Dissenter, Rebel; antonyms: Conformist, Traditionalist, Conventionalist.
B. Altruist = दूसरों के कल्याण की चिंता करने वाला व्यक्ति; synonyms: Philanthropist, Benefactor, Humanitarian; antonyms: Egoist, Selfish person, Misanthrope.
C. Sycophant = निजी लाभ के लिए प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति की चापलूसी करने वाला; synonyms: Toady, Flatterer, Bootlicker; antonyms: Critic, Detractor, Opponent.
D. Epicure = अच्छे भोजन और पेय का विशेष आनंद लेने वाला; synonyms: Gourmet, Connoisseur, Epicurean; antonyms: Ascetic, Abstemious person, Teetotaller.
questions.eh:
A. Maverick = परंपरा से अलग स्वतंत्र सोच वाला व्यक्ति; synonyms: Nonconformist, Dissenter, Rebel; antonyms: Conformist, Traditionalist, Conventionalist.
B. Altruist = दूसरों के कल्याण की चिंता करने वाला व्यक्ति; synonyms: Philanthropist, Benefactor, Humanitarian; antonyms: Egoist, Selfish person, Misanthrope.
C. Sycophant = निजी लाभ के लिए प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति की चापलूसी करने वाला; synonyms: Toady, Flatterer, Bootlicker; antonyms: Critic, Detractor, Opponent.

questions.q:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.
Not only did the investigative journalist uncover a massive financial fraud involving the offshore accounts, but he also revealed how deeply entrenched corruption was in the administrative machinery.
o: Not only did the investigative journalist uncover
a massive financial fraud involving the offshore accounts,
but he also revealed how deeply entrenched
questions.e:
There is no grammatical error. The correlative structure “not only ... but ... also” is correctly used, and inversion after sentence-initial “Not only” is also correct. Therefore, D. No Error.

Hindi Explanation: इस वाक्य में कोई grammatical error नहीं है। “Not only ... but ... also” का प्रयोग सही है और sentence के आरंभ में “Not only” आने पर inversion भी सही है। इसलिए D. No Error सही है।
questions.eh: इस वाक्य में कोई grammatical error नहीं है। “Not only ... but ... also” का प्रयोग सही है और sentence के आरंभ में “Not only” आने पर inversion भी सही है। इसलिए D. No Error सही है।

questions.q:
Identify the option that contains a spelling error within the given context.
A. The sovereign nation maintained its autonomy through strict diplomatic protocols.
B. The sudden obsolescence of the old manufacturing equipment paralyzed production.
C. The archeologist discovered a historical artifact that contradicted previous timeline hipotheses.
D. His magnanimous gesture toward his political rivals surprised the entire electorate.
o: The sovereign nation maintained its autonomy through strict diplomatic protocols.
The sudden obsolescence of the old manufacturing equipment paralyzed production.
The archeologist discovered a historical artifact that contradicted previous timeline hipotheses.
His magnanimous gesture toward his political rivals surprised the entire electorate.
questions.e:
C is incorrect because “hipotheses” is misspelt; the correct spelling is “hypotheses.”

Vocabulary: A. Sovereign = possessing supreme power or independence; synonyms: Supreme, Independent, Autonomous; antonyms: Subordinate, Dependent, Subjugated. B. Obsolescence = the state of becoming outdated; synonyms: Outdatedness, Obsoleteness, Desuetude; antonyms: Modernity, Currency, Novelty. C. Hypotheses = proposed explanations; synonyms: Theories, Postulates, Suppositions; antonyms: Facts, Certainties, Proofs. D. Magnanimous = generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival; synonyms: Generous, Noble, Big-hearted; antonyms: Petty, Vindictive, Mean-spirited.

Hindi Explanation: C में “hipotheses” की spelling गलत है; सही spelling “hypotheses” है।
A. Sovereign = सर्वोच्च शक्ति वाला/स्वतंत्र। B. Obsolescence = पुराना या अप्रचलित हो जाने की अवस्था। C. Hypotheses = परिकल्पनाएँ/प्रस्तावित explanations। D. Magnanimous = उदार और क्षमाशील।
Synonyms/antonyms ऊपर दिए गए अनुसार हैं।
questions.eh:
C में “hipotheses” की spelling गलत है; सही spelling “hypotheses” है।
A. Sovereign = सर्वोच्च शक्ति वाला/स्वतंत्र। B. Obsolescence = पुराना या अप्रचलित हो जाने की अवस्था। C. Hypotheses = परिकल्पनाएँ/प्रस्तावित explanations। D. Magnanimous = उदार और क्षमाशील।
Synonyms/antonyms ऊपर दिए गए अनुसार हैं।

Sovereign.meaning: Possessing supreme or ultimate power; independent.

Obsolescence.meaning: The state of becoming outdated or no longer useful.

Hypotheses.meaning: Plural of hypothesis; proposed explanations based on limited evidence.

Magnanimous.meaning: Generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival.

questions.q:
Choose the word that is closest in meaning to the given word.
The magistrate noted that the evidence presented by the prosecution was entirely tenuous, lacking any substantive material to link the accused directly to the white-collar crime. (Find Synonym)
questions.e:
The target word “tenuous” means very weak, slight, or insubstantial. B. Flimsy is the closest synonym.

Option meanings: A. Formidable = very powerful or impressive; an antonym. B. Flimsy = weak or lacking solidity; true synonym. C. Authentic = genuine or of undisputed origin. D. Equivocal = open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous.

Target vocabulary: Synonyms — Flimsy, Fragile, Insubstantial. Antonyms — Formidable, Robust, Substantial.

Hindi Explanation: “Tenuous” का अर्थ बहुत कमजोर, मामूली या ठोस आधार से रहित है। B. Flimsy इसका निकटतम synonym है।
A. Formidable = बहुत शक्तिशाली/प्रभावशाली। B. Flimsy = कमजोर/ठोस न होना। C. Authentic = वास्तविक/प्रामाणिक। D. Equivocal = जिसका अर्थ एक से अधिक हो सकता है/अस्पष्ट।
Synonyms: Flimsy, Fragile, Insubstantial. Antonyms: Formidable, Robust, Substantial.

questions.q:
Arrange the sentences in the most logical sequence.
P: This demographic shift has created an unprecedented demand for flexible healthcare policies that prioritize preventative care over emergency treatments.
Q: Furthermore, urban migration has compressed the available housing space, fundamentally altering family structures and support systems for the elderly.
R: Over the past two decades, the nation has witnessed a substantial transformation in its socio-economic landscape due to rapid industrial growth.
S: Consequently, municipal corporations are forced to re-evaluate their city planning layout to accommodate both commercial zoning and residential wellbeing.
questions.e:
The best sequence is RQPS (B). R introduces the broad socio-economic transformation. Q gives a concrete demographic development—urban migration and its effect on families. P begins with “This demographic shift,” referring back to Q. S then begins with “Consequently,” giving a resulting policy/planning response.

Hindi Explanation: सही क्रम RQPS (B) है। R व्यापक socio-economic transformation बताता है। Q urban migration और उसके family structure पर प्रभाव की बात करता है। P में “This demographic shift” Q के demographic development को refer करता है। S “Consequently” के साथ उसका परिणाम बताता है।
